tagline.en: Malaysia's biggest carrier's prepaid brand — native MY number, passport KYC, China roaming data packs
tagline.zh: 马来西亚最大运营商预付费品牌——原生MY号码，护照实名，支持回国漫游流量包

description.en: Hotlink is the prepaid brand of Maxis Berhad, Malaysia's largest mobile operator (launched 1999, own network — not an MVNO). Get the eSIM in-app for RM5 with passport KYC and a Malaysian address, top up RM20+ for signal, then buy roaming packs for China (e.g. RM100/40GB/30 days). Best keep-alive: RM30 for 180 days with 30GB — about RM60/year. WhatsApp registration verified; Google SMS verification failed in testing.
description.zh: Hotlink是马来西亚最大移动运营商Maxis Berhad（明讯）旗下的预付费品牌（1999年推出，自有网络非虚商）。App内护照实名+马来地址即可RM5开通eSIM，充值20RM以上来信号，再购买中国漫游包（如RM100/40GB/30天）。最划算保号：RM30得180天有效期+30GB流量，年保号约RM60。实测注册WhatsApp成功；Google账号短信验证失败。

details.en: Hotlink is the quality route to a native Malaysian +60 number: Maxis's own network (fast and stable in cities), full in-app onboarding, and roaming packs that actually work in mainland China — a 1-day 1GB pack tested at a genuine Malaysian IP (Maxis network) with Speedtest at 58.59 Mbps, fine for video or streaming. Acquisition (2026-01 source review): install the Hotlink app on a native-eSIM phone (eSIM chips like Xesim/9eSIM are NOT supported), choose 'Activate or Get New SIM' → eSIM → RM5 plan → passport photo KYC → pick a number → enter email plus a Malaysian address found on Google Maps → pay by Visa/Mastercard. Key trap: after download the eSIM shows NO signal until you top up at least RM20 — smaller top-ups leave it dead, and it looks like failed activation. Second trap: do NOT turn on data roaming before buying a roaming pack — base roaming rates silently burn your balance. Roaming packs live under Home → Roaming → China: the value pick is 30 days / 40GB / RM100 (a 1-day/1GB/RM20 pack exists for quick tests). Keep-alive: plain top-ups are poor value (RM10 = +30 days, RM5 = +5 days, ~RM120/year); the smart route is the 180-day 30GB pass at RM30 — about RM60/year. A legendary RM30/365-day no-data pass has been delisted and no longer appears in-app. Registration reality check: WhatsApp signup worked; Google account SMS verification failed even with balance — the source suspects the bundle only covers ordinary domestic P2P SMS, not short-code or international destinations. Passport KYC is mandatory.
details.zh: Hotlink是获取马来西亚原生+60号码的品质路线：Maxis自有网络（城市快且稳）、全流程App内办理、中国大陆漫游包真实可用——实测1天1GB包为真马来西亚IP（Maxis网络），Speedtest 58.59Mbps，看视频直播没问题。获取流程（2026-01源测评）：原生eSIM手机装Hotlink App（不支持Xesim/9esim等eSIM芯片卡）→「Activate or Get New SIM」→eSIM→RM5套餐→拍护照实名→选号→填邮箱+Google地图上找的马来西亚地址→Visa/Mastercard支付。关键坑一：eSIM下载后无余额无信号，须充值至少20RM才有信号，充少了照样无服务，别误以为激活失败。关键坑二：买漫游包之前千万别开数据漫游，基础漫游资费会静默扣掉余额。漫游包在App主页Roaming→China：性价比之选是30天40GB RM100（还有1天1GB RM20供快速测试）。保号：纯充值不划算（RM10加30天、RM5加5天，一年约RM120）；聪明路线是RM30的180天30GB套餐，年保号约RM60。曾经的RM30保一年（无流量）神套餐已下架，App内找不到了。注册实测：WhatsApp注册成功；Google账号短信验证失败（充值后仍发不出），源推测套餐只含普通国内点对点短信、不含短号或国际短信。护照实名强制。

bestFor.en: Users who need a native Malaysian number (WhatsApp etc.) with real China-roaming data, and accept passport KYC plus ~RM60/year.
bestFor.zh: 需要原生马来西亚号码（注册WhatsApp等）+真实回国漫游流量，能接受护照实名与年约RM60持有的用户。

Never enable data roaming before buying a pack — balance burns
